content: संगत {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Joined or united with, come together, associated with; तदा गन्तव्यमनिशं भवद्भिरिह संगतैः <ls>Rām. 7. 36. 58</ls>. .²2 Assembled, collected, convened, met together. .²3 Joined in wedlock, married. .²4 Sexually united. .²5 Fitted together, appropriate, harmonious; शृणुतमिदानीं संगतार्था न वेति <ls>Ś. 3</ls>. .²6 In conjunction with (as planets). .²7 Shrunk up, contracted; see गम् with सम्. .{@-तम्@} Union, meeting, alliance; संगतं श्रीसरस्वत्योर्भूतयेऽस्तु सदा सताम् <ls>V. 5. 24</ls>; <ls>Ś. 5. 24</ls>; <ls>Ki. 14. 22</ls>. .²2 Association, company. .²3 Acquaintance, friendship, intimacy; यतः सतां संनतगात्रि संगतं मनीषिभिः साप्तपदीनमुच्यते <ls>Ku. 5. 39</ls>. .²4 A harmonious or consistent speech, well-reasoned remarks.
